_doc: One row per Esc-menu setting, in menu order. tab: game|keys|audio|video|crosshair. kind: slider (min/max/step), toggle, choice (choices split on |, value = index), binds (one row expands to every input.json row). convar is the CS2 convar the value comes from (the player's cs2_user_convars.vcfg first, this default second) and is written back into Hud.convars for crosshair rows. Slider start values are the player's convars as written (not clamped or rounded); only values the player changes are saved (user://settings.json, written to a temp file and renamed).

rows.label: Show speed
rows.verified: mashup setting, nothing to check in CS2
